lead_headline: Mother Other's vegan debut hits Baker as 1up LoDo shuts down after 15 years and Magna Kainan closes RiNo after 18 months

restaurant.blurb: 3 leads today: Mother Other (Baker vegan, Chef Mandolini's new concept), Tacos Samy truck (Chaffee Park closed), Good Girl Cafe & Bookstore (Rosedale romance-bookstore hybrid prepping). Active: 139 openings, 120 closures.

liquor.blurb: Thirteenth zero day extends statewide freeze to 30 days total—full month now with 7-day count frozen at 369 licenses, all still carrying June 14 timestamps from mid-month backlog dump. No new applications, status changes, or removals since system shutdown began. Paralysis persists against 800+ monthly baseline as June closes with no processing activity visible.

reputation.blurb: +6 mentions yesterday hold steady with prior day's +11, pushing 7-day total to 62 across 10 sources—up 9% from prior week's 57. Facebook leads with 22 citations (35% share), Reddit adds 9, Hoodline and Instagram tie at 7 and 6, Denver Post contributes 6. Downtown ghost tower story and Centennial Gardens closure dominated coverage. Monthly tally reaches 210. Google News RSS captured 58 of 62 (94%).

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) extends flatline to eight consecutive zero days, holding MTD at +19 (+0.7/day) and 90-day net at +129. Current June 22-29 freeze—just −4 net across eight days with 6 cancellations outpacing 2 new—contrasts sharply with robust June 16-21 stretch that posted +11 net. Eight-day dormancy marks longest standstill this quarter, pulling MTD pace below YTD baseline of +1.2/day as June closes.
